stages.reference:
Create a close visual reference for dense jungle canopy foliage in an ancient humid dark-fantasy world.

These leaves live beneath relentless moisture, heat and competition for light. The foliage should feel broad, layered and vigorous but not cheerful: deep humid greens, shadowed overlapping growth, leathery wet-aged surfaces, small tears, insect wear and occasional muted yellowing. Dense life should create visual depth without becoming an indistinct green mass.

Avoid decorative tropical-houseplant imagery, neon emerald color, giant identifiable flowers, excessive water droplets or a pristine botanical photograph. The jungle is old, oppressive and biologically rich.

Establish a distinctive material language of layered humid foliage, with irregular density and age. Do not copy or anticipate the game's leaf arrangement; this is the visual reference that will guide it.

FOLIAGE POROSITY: Preserve approximately the original texture's overall opaque-to-transparent area ratio, not its alpha mask. Freely redesign every gap's position, shape and distribution, as well as leaf clusters and overlaps. Keep genuine fully transparent openings between foliage; do not fill the whole square with continuous leaf material or render a solid cube face. No exact pixel or silhouette tracing. Retain neutral, runtime-tint-friendly value detail where applicable.
